subject: Production token failures — reserved pool saturation impacting BankWise payments
messages:
From: Ken Olson <ken.olson@bankwise.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: BankWise SRE <sre@bankwise.com>
Date: 2027-03-16T07:42:00Z
Subject: High 5xx & timeouts in payments flow — urgent

Ben —

We're seeing a sustained spike in 5xx errors and timeouts on our production payment scoring route since ~07:00 UTC. Latency has climbed from 120ms p50 to >2s p50 and a large fraction of requests are returning 502/504. This is happening despite us being within our committed RCU (reserved throughput) for the month. Impact: several downstream systems are queueing and transactions are failing at peak load.

I attached a short error sample and our client-side retry trace. Please let us know:
- Are there known capacity regressions for reserved pools in us-east-1?
- Can you confirm whether our reserved throughput is being bumped or throttled?
- Immediate mitigation steps we can take (we cannot divert traffic without coordination).

This is P1 for us — production payments. Requesting an emergency response and an ETA for remediation.

—Ken
Ken Olson
Head of SRE, BankWise
Attachment: error-sample-20270316.log (text/plain)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ken Olson <ken.olson@bankwise.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-16T07:55:00Z
Subject: Re: High 5xx & timeouts in payments flow — urgent

Ken — thanks for the heads up and the logs. I'm opening this thread in our mailbox and looping in SE/Ops. We're treating as P0. Immediate plan:
1) Dylan — can you pull pool-level metrics (queue depth, GPU utilization, active batches) for BankWise's Dedicated pool (pool-id: ded-BW-01) and confirm whether there's saturation or misrouting?
2) Grace — I'll coordinate customer comms and request permission for a temporary uplift or fallback policy.
3) Marissa/Vivek — FYI for exec visibility; if this is reserved-thru drift we may need policy overrides (autoscale or borrow headroom).

Suggested immediate mitigations for Ken (if acceptable):
- Reduce client concurrency by 20% for the next 30m while we triage (quickest to implement on your side).
- We can flip traffic to the lower-capacity model-variant (quantized) for payments scoring to reduce per-token GPU work; this is a config change we can do in ~10–15m after approval.

Ken — do you approve temporary traffic routing to quantized-variant (loss tolerable for short window) and a short uplift if needed? I'll await replies and provide hourly updates.

Ben Carter
Account Lead — Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1-415-555-0123
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ken Olson <ken.olson@bankwise.com>
Date: 2027-03-16T08:12:00Z
Subject: Re: High 5xx & timeouts in payments flow — urgent

Ben / Ken — initial triage notes (metrics attached):
- Pool ded-BW-01 shows sustained GPU utilization at 98–100% across the last 45m.
- Queue depth (per-inference queue) spiked from ~250 to >1,200 concurrent items; token-level throughput is hitting the configured commit but actual effective throughput is lower due to long-tail batches.
- We see elevated KV cache misses for the model (increase in context window usage), which inflates per-request compute.
- There are multiple clients sending larger-than-usual batch sizes (looks like new client rollout from BankWise mobile).

Attachments: pool-metrics-03-16.png (pool CPU/GPU/queue charts)

Immediate technical mitigations we can execute now (need customer OK for routing/changes):
A) Route a portion (~30%) of traffic to quantized-variant (model-q-v2) — reduces GPU time per request ~35%. Estimated action time: 10–20m.
B) Apply emergency throttle on burst concurrency for non-critical routes to preserve headroom for payments-scoring. Estimated action time: 5–10m but requires coordination with BankWise to avoid client timeouts.
C) Temporarily increase ded-BW-01 capacity by borrowing from pooled headroom (if account-level policy allows) — this requires Marissa/Vivek approval; could bring immediate relief in 15–30m.

If we don't get a routing change, I expect queueing to persist for the next 2–3 hours during morning peak. Recommend we do A + C simultaneously to minimize impact.

—Dylan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Ken Olson <ken.olson@bankwise.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-16T08:25:00Z
Subject: Re: High 5xx & timeouts in payments flow — urgent

Ken — quick customer-facing plan and asks so your SRE and product teams can action immediately: 
1) We will push model-q-v2 routing for the payments-scoring endpoint. Ben, Dylan: request to schedule the switch now if Ken approves.
2) Marissa/Vivek: please approve a temporary capacity uplift of +20% to ded-BW-01 for the next 6 hours as an emergency measure while we normalize traffic patterns. We'll reconcile billing/credit after the incident (we'll propose a goodwill credit for the impact window).
3) BankWise to reduce client-side concurrency for any batch submitters that began rollout in last 24h (we can provide config guidance).

If Ken approves the routing change, we will execute A (routing) immediately and request C (temporary uplift). Once executed, we will monitor p50/p95 and error rate every 5 minutes and update. 

Attached: agreement-redline-v2.pdf (temporary uplift terms + credit proposal)

Please confirm the two approvals below:
- ACCEPT_ROUTING_CHANGE: yes/no
- ACCEPT_TEMP_UPLIFT: yes/no (we will proceed on explicit yes from your procurement/SRE lead)

Grace O'Connor
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: agreement-redline-v2.pdf (pdf)
From: Ken Olson <ken.olson@bankwise.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-17T10:18:00Z
Subject: Re: High 5xx & timeouts in payments flow — urgent

Grace / team —
We approve the routing change to model-q-v2 and approve the temporary +20% uplift for the next 6 hours. Please proceed. We appreciate the credit offer — Ken O. will follow up with procurement on formal signoff for the uplift paperwork but this is our operational green light.

Please ping when the initial metrics show p95 back under 800ms and error rate trending down. Thanks for the fast response.

—Ken
Ken Olson
Head of SRE, BankWise
